title: Open Mic @ The Western Horseman Club
event_description: Weekly open mic night hosted by Colten Witcher at one of Amarillo's premier live music venues. Musicians of all genres welcome to perform in this historic cowboy club.
event_venue_information:
About The Western Horseman Club

The Western Horseman Club is a revitalized Amarillo institution that first opened in 1983 as one of the area's premiere cowboy clubs. After a renovation in 2023 the venue has returned to its former glory as a destination for dining dancing and live music.

Live Music & Entertainment

The venue features live music Thursday through Saturday nights with a mix of country rock and various genres. The historic sawdust-covered dance floor invites guests to two-step the night away. Monday nights feature jazz musicians and the venue hosts regular open mic nights on Wednesdays.

Dining Experience

The Western Horseman offers full-service dining with a menu featuring steaks burgers and other American cuisine. The restaurant serves brunch on weekends and maintains a full bar with craft cocktails. The venue is located inside the Cactus Cove Inn and Suites.

title: Open Mic @ The 806 Coffee + Lounge
event_description: Amarillo's longest-running open mic night featuring local and traveling musicians poets and performers. This eclectic coffee house hosts multiple open mic formats throughout the month.
event_venue_information:
About The 806 Coffee + Lounge

Established in 2007 in Amarillo's Historic Route 66 District The 806 Coffee + Lounge has become a cultural cornerstone for the city's artistic community. This coffee house and performance venue combines quality beverages with regular live entertainment and art exhibitions.

Open Mic Nights

The 806 hosts Amarillo's longest-running open mic series with regular events on the 2nd and 4th Wednesday of each month. A Music Open Mic takes place on the 3rd Wednesday and a Fright Night Open Mic happens on the 3rd Thursday. The venue also features a monthly jazz jam session led by local musicians.

Venue Atmosphere

The space features vintage furniture alongside contemporary art from local artists creating an inviting and inspiring atmosphere. Monthly art walks and First Thursday events showcase local talent with art openings receptions and live music starting at 9pm.

Food & Drink

The 806 specializes in fair-trade and organic coffees teas and natural beverages. The menu is entirely vegetarian with many vegan options including house-made chili hummus and baked goods. The venue offers craft beers wines and specialty drinks.

title: Open Mic Night @ Shark Beach
event_description: Seasonal open mic night at Amarillo's unique beach-themed venue. Performers can showcase their talents in a relaxed outdoor atmosphere with sand under their feet.
venue_address: 1505 E Farm to Market Rd 1151 Amarillo TX 79118
event_venue_information:
About Shark Beach

Shark Beach is Amarillo's only beachfront venue featuring genuine sand volleyball courts and an outdoor music stage. Originally Grams Burger Farm the venue was rebranded in 2020 by the grandson who grew up on South Padre Island and brought island vibes to the Texas Panhandle.

Music Season

The music season runs from May through October with over 100 live music nights each summer. The venue hosts free live music nights weekly karaoke sessions and open mic opportunities. Ticketed tribute band concerts are scheduled throughout the season featuring classic rock pop and country acts.

Venue Features

The outdoor venue accommodates up to 2500 guests for ticketed shows. Free music nights create a relaxed family-friendly atmosphere. Guests bring fold-up chairs and enjoy shows under the wide-open Texas sky. No outside food or drinks are allowed but the venue serves burgers and beverages.

Food & Atmosphere

Shark Beach specializes in classic burgers with fresh bakery buns and hand-cut fries. The beach atmosphere includes sand for guests to relax in surfboard photo opportunities and a casual island vibe. Mixed beverages and beer are available.

title: Karaoke Night @ The Lumberyard
event_description: Thursday night karaoke at Canyon's newest entertainment destination. Sing your favorite songs while enjoying great food and craft beer in a relaxed West Texas atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About The Lumberyard

The Lumberyard opened in Canyon Texas in May 2024 as a premier concert venue and restaurant. Located just 20 minutes from downtown Amarillo this modern facility combines dining entertainment and community gathering spaces in a revitalized property.

Live Music & Events

The venue hosts major concerts throughout the year featuring Texas country Red Dirt Americana and rock acts. Thursday nights feature karaoke while Friday nights bring live music on the weeknights. The outdoor concert space and indoor restaurant create versatile entertainment options year-round.

Dining Experience

The restaurant opened in March 2025 with a full menu and bar service. The venue features a 36000 square-foot patio and banquet facilities that can accommodate up to 3300 guests. A wall of self-serve beer taps offers variety and the kitchen serves diverse cuisine.

Community Impact

As part of Canyon's growth The Lumberyard represents a significant investment in the community. The venue hosts everything from intimate songwriter nights to large-scale festivals. The property was developed on former lumberyard land transforming unused space into a cultural hub.
